description: Defines a UserModel class representing user data, including methods for constructing an instance from a Firebase user object and converting to a map.

classes.name: UserModel
classes.description: An immutable data class representing a user with properties such as uid, displayName, email, and photoUrl, along with factory and serialization methods.

methods.name: UserModel.fromFirebaseUser
methods.description: Factory constructor that creates a UserModel instance from a generic FirebaseUser object, safely casting and extracting user properties.

methods.name: toMap
methods.description: Converts the UserModel instance into a Map<String, Object?> for serialization or storage.
